result.instructions: Tools for LeadDyno, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which affiliates signed up this week and are still waiting for approval?"; "What were our total affiliate commissions for October, and how much is still due?"; "Show me the purchases referred by affiliates in the last 30 days, including cancellations.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LeadDyno data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run leaddyno_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run leaddyno_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run leaddyno_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. leaddyno_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: leaddyno_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List affiliates in the LeadDyno program, filtered by a search string (first name, last name or email) and by created or updated time. Vendor: GET /affiliates.

query.description: Text to find in first name, last name or email.

tools.name: leaddyno_get_affiliate
tools.title: Get affiliate
tools.description: Get one affiliate by its LeadDyno id, with status, affiliate code, referrer and archive flag. Vendor: GET /affiliates/{id}.

tools.name: leaddyno_get_affiliate_by_email
tools.title: Get affiliate by email
tools.description: Find one affiliate by the email address they signed up with. Vendor: GET /affiliates/by_email.

tools.name: leaddyno_get_affiliate_by_code
tools.title: Get affiliate by code
tools.description: Find one affiliate by their affiliate or coupon code. Vendor: GET /affiliates/by_affiliate_code.

affiliate_code.description: The affiliate's coupon or discount code.

tools.name: leaddyno_list_affiliate_groups
tools.title: List affiliate groups
tools.description: List affiliate groups (commission tiers and program segments). Vendor: GET /affiliate_groups.

tools.name: leaddyno_list_purchases
tools.title: List purchases
tools.description: List purchases tracked through the program, filtered by created, updated or cancelled time, and optionally only affiliate-referred purchases. Vendor: GET /purchases.

affiliates_only.description: Return only purchases referred by affiliates (default false).

include_line_items.description: Include SKU line items for each purchase (default false).

tools.name: leaddyno_get_purchase
tools.title: Get purchase
tools.description: Get one purchase by its LeadDyno id, with amount, currency, referral source, cancellation and lead. Vendor: GET /purchases/{id}.

tools.name: leaddyno_list_commissions
tools.title: List commissions
tools.description: List commissions earned by affiliates, filtered by created or updated time, exact or partial note text, and affiliate group. Vendor: GET /commissions.

note.description: Exact, case-insensitive match on the commission note.

tools.name: leaddyno_get_commission_totals
tools.title: Get commission totals
tools.description: Get commission totals (counts and costs: total, cancelled, due and paid) for a date range, optionally for one affiliate or note. Vendor: GET /commissions/totals.

start_date.description: Start of the range, yyyy-mm-dd (default: all time).

end_date.description: End of the range, yyyy-mm-dd (default: now).

currency.description: Currency code, for example USD (default: the account currency).

note.description: Exact, case-insensitive match on the commission note.

tools.name: leaddyno_get_lead_by_email
tools.title: Get lead by email
tools.description: Find one lead (a referred or tracked contact) by email address, with status, custom status and address fields. Vendor: GET /leads/by_email.

tools.name: leaddyno_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List tracking campaigns, filtered by created or updated time. Vendor: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: leaddyno_approve_affiliate
tools.title: Approve affiliate
tools.description: Approve a pending affiliate so they can earn commissions and sign in to the affiliate area. Vendor: POST /affiliates/{id}/approve. Calling it again on an approved affiliate is harmless.

tools.name: leaddyno_reject_affiliate
tools.title: Reject affiliate
tools.description: Reject a pending affiliate application, so they do not join the program. Check the affiliate with leaddyno_get_affiliate first. Vendor: POST /affiliates/{id}/reject.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with LeadDyno
prompts.description: What you can do with LeadDyno here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_new_affiliate_applications
prompts.title: Review new affiliate applications
prompts.description: Filter affiliates by name, email or created time. Open an applicant to read its status and referrer.

prompts.name: approve_or_reject_a_pending_affiliate
prompts.title: Approve or reject a pending affiliate
prompts.description: Check the affiliate first. Then approve it so it can earn commissions, or reject the application.

prompts.name: check_commission_totals_for_a_period
prompts.title: Check commission totals for a period
prompts.description: Get the commission counts and costs for a date range, per affiliate or note. List the commissions behind the totals.

prompts.name: trace_purchases_that_affiliates_referred
prompts.title: Trace purchases that affiliates referred
prompts.description: List purchases in a time range, optionally only affiliate-referred ones, including cancellations. Open one for its amount and referral source.

prompts.name: find_an_affiliate_or_lead_by_code_or_email
prompts.title: Find an affiliate or lead by code or email
prompts.description: Look up an affiliate by affiliate or coupon code, or by email. Look up a lead by its email address.
